user.title: Device Floorplan
user.description: Device Floorplan adds a **Floorplan Editor** to your sidebar. There you create your first plan from a drawing, a photo or a sample, and place your devices on it.

init.title: New devices
init.description: What happens when you add a device to Home Assistant after setting up your plans.

data.notify_new_devices: Show a notification when new devices are added
data.auto_place_new_devices: Put new devices on the plan next to their room (approximate)

get_positions.name: Get positions
get_positions.description: Returns the devices, room pins and scale of one plan.

plan.name: Plan
plan.description: Plan id or name, e.g. ground_floor.

show_overlay.name: Show overlay
show_overlay.description: Switches every Device Floorplan card with this card ID to an overlay and/or a floor, on every screen.

card_id.name: Card ID
card_id.description: The card ID set in the card editor.

overlay.name: Overlay
overlay.description: plan, live, lights, comfort, security, network, health, a custom overlay's ID, or reset (back to the card's default).

floor.name: Floor
floor.description: Optional: the plan id (or HA floor id) of the floor to show, for cards with several floors.
